headline: Fire Department reviewed proposed projects, including $1,981,000 Rescue 1 replacement and $279,000 Zetron system upgrade.
summary: Fire Chief Jim Young reviewed proposed projects for apparatus, facilities, equipment, and communications. He said many requests are for FY27 because the department has not invested in the CIP for many years. Members also approved prior meeting minutes 5-0.
decisions: Agreed to let Kate Burbidge take part in the meeting remotely.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Paul made a motion to approve the July 21, 2026, meeting minutes as presented. Ms. Verani seconded the motion. A roll call vote was taken. The motion carried 5-0-0.
The Committee agreed to allow Ms. Burbidge to participate remotely.
